title: Adaptive slit reservoir and utilization median sampler
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Introduce an adaptive slit-based reservoir allocator to reduce headroom fragmentation and a median-based utilization sampler to produce more robust autoscaling signals. Backwards-compatible config flags and a gradual rollout are included.
body: Motivation: Current per-tenant headroom and burst accounting can fragment capacity under mixed-duration workloads. Short, frequent bursts create noisy util signals and cause reactive autoscaling that widens latency tail and increases cost. This PR introduces two complementary pieces: (1) an adaptive 'slit reservoir' allocator that partitions pool capacity into variable-width slits sized by observed burst length distributions and protocolized refill/borrow rules, and (2) a utilization median sampler that replaces the mean-based sampler for autoscaler input to reduce sensitivity to transient microbursts. Design summary: The slit reservoir is an allocator module added to the fleet capacity controller. Slits are created per-pool and per-class (dedicated/dedicated-burst) where each slit has a soft quota and an aging score that decays with usage; slits can lend to each other via a bounded borrow protocol that enforces a per-tenant fairness cap. The median sampler computes a rolling median over an exponential sliding window of per-slot occupancy percentiles rather than averaging raw util numbers, and exposes a median-driven utilization metric util_median_1m, util_median_5m used by the autoscaler instead of util_p95 signals. Backwards compatibility: Defaults preserve current behavior; the feature is toggleable via fleet config flags: enable_slit_reservoir and use_median_sampler. Rollout plan: Gated rollout by pool label: start with internal dev pools (1%), expand to test pools (5%), then staged production (25/50/100) with telemetry checks. Telemetry & alerts: New metrics ship under redwood.autoscale.* and redwood.reservoir.* including slit_count, slit_fragmentation_ratio, util_median_1m, util_median_5m, median_vs_mean_delta. Added greppable logs for borrow/refund events. Testing: Unit tests for allocator invariants, property tests for borrow symmetry, and integration test with the autoscaler harness using synthetic burst traces. Performance: Allocation bookkeeping has been implemented with lock-free ring buffers and a low-cost tidy path; microbenchmarks show <1.2% extra CPU on controller leader under 10k tenants. Safety/rollback: Feature flags allow immediate disable; a revert path is documented. Related: ENG-5112 covers the analytic work that motivated the slit heuristics; SUP-1123 is the customer incident that surfaced burst-induced oscillations. Summary of changes: added allocator logic, new median sampler, config toggles, telemetry, unit/integration tests, docs and a migration note.

review_comments: Luca Rossi: Overall idea looks solid; two quick asks: (1) add circuit-breaker if borrow path fails repeatedly so we don't starve primary slits, (2) please add a small note about expected memory overhead for ring buffers.
Maya Patel (author): Addressed (1) by adding borrow_failure_counter with a fast-fail threshold and (2) documented expected per-pool memory in allocator.go header. Pushed a follow-up commit b27f4ee.
Priya Singh: Tests look good, but can you add a short integration scenario where a long-running tenant vs bursty tenants co-exist to show fairness preserved?
Maya Patel: Added integration case to autoscaler harness and included results in the PR description under Testing. See commit c9f1b22.
Dana Kim: CI flake on autoscaler sampler test earlier; reran and greened. Approved after flake cleared.
Luca Rossi: Approving with one optional nit on metric naming (s/pluralization).
ci_summary: CI pipeline: unit-tests -> integration-harness -> lint -> e2e-smoke. Unit tests passed. Integration harness passed (synthetic traces). Lint fixed on first run. One transient test failure on autoscaler sampler flaked and was rerun; final status: pass.
merge_commit: d4e5f3a merged: squash 'Adaptive slit reservoir and utilization median sampler'
tests_summary: Unit: 92 passed, 3 property tests. Integration: burst-harness scenarios (10/10). Load microbench: controller leaderboard under 10k tenants: CPU +0.9% median. E2E smoke: passed.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: feature off by default. Phase 1: enable_slit_reservoir=true/use_median_sampler=false on dev pools (1%) for 48h. Phase 2: enable both flags on staging/test pools (5-10%) for 72h with autoscale guardrails. Phase 3: 25%/50%/100% staged production ramp with telemetry SLO checks at each step. Emergency rollback: flip flags to false and allow 15m stabilization window.
operator_notes: Docs include borrowing failure escalation, and a small script to extract slit fragmentation per-pool. Operator can set env SLIT_MAX_BORROW=0 to disable cross-slit lending for critical pools.
acknowledgements: Thanks to the autoscale team for the harness traces (Priya), runtime team for low-level allocator review (Luca), and SRE for telemetry naming guidance (Dana).
